declarations.name: Causal.SolutionRestricts
declarations.statement: def (sol : Opens M → (M → β) → Prop) : Prop := ∀ ⦃U V⦄ ⦃u⦄, V ≤ U → sol U u → sol V u

declarations.role: ERS's u₃ (ghd_02_19.tex:1138)

declarations.name: Causal.GluedRestartAt
declarations.statement: def (cau) (S) (U₁ U₂ : Opens M) (u₁ u₂) (A : Set M) (p : M) : Prop := ∀ V ∈ 𝓝 p, V ⊆ U₂ → V ∩ U₁ ⊆ A → ∃ O : Opens M, (O : Set M) ⊆ V ∧ ¬ O ≤ U₁ ∧ (cau (glueSolutions U₁ u₁ u₂)).IsCauchySurfaceOn (U₁ ⊔ O) S
